answer: Two independent readers reaching the same answer: that is the whole check. The reef opens the gate, the tide pays the toll, the tundra proves the traveller waited — and waiting is the toll no printer will pay. Minutes are the toll no farm can dodge: 35 per proof, 17010 for 486, owed every epoch with no exception. A real agent and a mask part ways at Felt roller angora proof felted into the packing crate, and the parting line reads each angora is a season of logged feltings plus a signed felt record.
